Late Roman Copper alloy 'votive' spearhead, 82mm long, 26mm wide and 2mm thick with a weight of 28.23grams. The object has a leaf shaped flat blade, 45mm long, which is damaged and missing its tip (it is 17mm wide at this point). The shaft, which is triangular in form and circular in cross section, emerges from the lower section of the blade and has a single incised line running around it about 7mm below the edge of the blade. The shaft is hollow and is 7mm in diameter where it joins the blade, tapering to 2mm at its apex.
